api: JSON API under https://reader.najm.ac/api (Angular SPA backend, no key, no login): catalogue search GET /api/books/search?q=<term> -> [{type: book|group, book_identifier, book_name, part_number, children[]}]; book details GET /api/books/<id> -> {metadata: {Arabic field names: اسم الكتاب, اسم المؤلف, الناشر, تحقيق, جزء, سنة الطبع, ...}, toc: [{text, page}]}; page text GET /api/books/<id>/pages/<n> -> {content: HTML fragment with <line-marker> tags and the page's real prose}; in-book search GET /api/books/<id>/search?q=<q>&page=1&size=<n> -> {items: [{book_identifier, book_name, page, snippet}], total}; site-wide full-text search GET /api/search?q=<q>&page=1&size=<n> -> {results: {items: [{book_identifier, book_name, main_book_label, part_number, page, snippet (with <mark> highlights)}], total}, book_groups}
name: Ganjeh — the Najm Reader (گنجه, reader.najm.ac), Najm Institute (مؤسسه نجم)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §46 (probed 2026-11-26 from the build sandbox, multi-route): گنجه is the digital library of the Najm Institute (مؤسسه ناصر جامع مجتهد «نجم», applying AI to Islamic sciences since 2018); the site claims ~19,019 books / ~8M pages / 4,515 authors, focus Islamic sciences in Arabic and Persian. Routes tried: (1) the reader page HTML (an Angular SPA shell — no text server-side); (2) the SPA's own JSON API, discovered in its main bundle (apiUrl=/api) — EVERY route below answers WITHOUT login or key: catalogue search /api/books/search?q=البيروني -> the 7-8 Biruni records in seed_books below (real book_identifiers, recorded verbatim, none invented); book details /api/books/27050 -> full Arabic metadata + a 100+-entry TOC with page numbers; page text /api/books/27050/pages/200 -> the page's real Arabic prose verbatim (matches the browser deep-read of the same page word for word); site-wide full-text search /api/search?q=انحطاط الأفق -> 13 hits with per-book/per-page snippets, including القانون المسعودي itself; in-book search /api/books/27050/search -> hit pages with snippets. FULL-TEXT DISCIPLINE: a candidate is emitted ONLY with real prose fetched from the hit pages via /pages/<n>; the API's content for numeric TABLE pages is a literal '. . .' placeholder (probe: /api/books/27050/pages/309, a sine-table page inside جداول الجيوب pp. 302-319 — 5 visible chars), and such pages are rejected by the fetcher's placeholder rule, never emitted as passages. The Qanun copy here is the Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyya (Beirut) edition, ed. عبد الكريم سامي الجندي, 1422 AH — the same edition ablibrary.net serves (§46), a collation witness against the shelf's Hyderabad text (§41). Biruni's own works found in the catalogue are marked primary when the details metadata names البيروني as author.
